scope.goal: test whether broad v1 plp_dependent_enzyme fingerprint can be split into mechanism-relevant child strata and whether learned/geometry channels distinguish them beyond cofactor recognition

disk_guardrail.note: The first df check in the original automation worktree reported about 4.8 GiB free; later environment cleanup/pruning recovered space before these small artifacts were written.

child_strata.panel_use: positive child stratum and parent PLP cofactor-control slice
child_strata.rationale: Multiple current702 M-CSA positives plus the frozen external aminotransferase mini-campaign give good source and structure coverage, but most external candidates are structural duplicates/leakage and no child-specific transamination geometry channel exists yet.
evidence_missing: source-free amino-donor/acceptor atom mapping and external-aldimine/product-state annotation
fold-diverse external positives that pass targeted current-PLP duplicate screens
child-specific negatives inside the same PLP fold after cofactor/name ablation

child_strata.panel_use: positive child stratum with ornithine/dealkylglycine decarboxylase controls
child_strata.rationale: Current rows cover ODC-like and dialkylglycine decarboxylase chemistry, but breadth is narrow and analog/product-state evidence is uneven.
evidence_missing: source-free carboxylate-position evidence and CO2-loss reaction-center annotation
at least three additional fold-diverse PLP decarboxylase positives
near-family PLP lyase/racemase controls with similar PLP internal aldimine geometry

child_strata.panel_use: positive child stratum plus non-PLP racemase OOS contrast
child_strata.rationale: Alanine racemase and serine racemase give two current positives, with glutamate racemase as a useful non-PLP OOS contrast, but true epimerase breadth is missing.
evidence_missing: more PLP racemase/epimerase positives outside the alanine/serine pair
source-free dual-face acid/base geometry and stereochemical product-state evidence
tests that reject non-PLP racemase wording without relying on PLP presence alone

child_strata.panel_use: positive child stratum, including beta-elimination and C-S/N-S cleavage
child_strata.rationale: Several M-CSA PLP lyases/eliminases are present, but the child boundary against beta/gamma replacement and non-PLP Schiff-base lyases remains under-specified.
evidence_missing: source-free leaving-group atom and quinonoid/external-aldimine state evidence
evidence-complete external Q96I15-like lyase rows before use as support
hard negatives where lyase wording is non-PLP or heme/flavin-associated

child_strata.panel_use: positive child stratum for beta/gamma substitution and replacement chemistry
child_strata.rationale: Tryptophan synthase, cystathionine beta/gamma enzymes, cysteine synthase, and tyrosine phenol-lyase provide useful anchors, but atom-level replacement state is not yet represented.
evidence_missing: explicit beta/gamma atom mapping with entering and leaving group identities
substrate/analog complexes that distinguish replacement from simple elimination
cross-stratum negatives from aminotransferases and decarboxylases in similar PLP folds

child_strata.panel_use: near-family hard negatives for requested children inside the broad PLP parent
child_strata.rationale: These rows show the broad parent PLP fingerprint is not a mechanism child: one-carbon transfer, phosphorylase, aminomutase, AONS/GAT-like carbon chemistry, and radical-SAM PLP contexts should abstain from requested child calls.
evidence_missing: negative labels or evaluation-only child exclusions for PLP-parent rows outside requested strata
ablation tests showing cofactor recognition alone does not trigger a child mechanism

child_strata.panel_use: coupled-cofactor boundary and beta-lysine aminomutase schema-gap sentinel
child_strata.rationale: Prior decision context explicitly rejected forcing m_csa:737 into plain PLP, plain cobalamin, or multi-target production counting.
evidence_missing: dedicated coupled PLP-adenosylcobalamin ontology/fingerprint specification
independent positive exemplars beyond m_csa:737
PLP-only, cobalamin-only, and radical-SAM aminomutase controls under a leakage-audited schema

child_strata.panel_use: near-family hard negatives for coupled PLP+B12 and PLP child rows
child_strata.rationale: Plain adenosylcobalamin radical rearrangements are necessary controls so coupled PLP+B12 is not learned as generic B12.
evidence_missing: paired split design with m_csa:737 after coupled-family schema exists
geometry channel that distinguishes absent PLP from coupled PLP+B12 active sites

child_strata.panel_use: hard negatives for PLP and child strata under Schiff-base/name leakage
child_strata.rationale: Several M-CSA OOS rows and prior Q9BXD5/P06746 controls test whether a learned model confuses generic lysine Schiff-base or lyase wording with PLP-dependent chemistry.
evidence_missing: source-free Schiff-base axis extraction for current M-CSA control rows

negative-control calibration against PLP lyases after text/name ablation

evidence_missing: more non-PLP racemase/epimerase controls with local coordinate evidence

v2_child_stratum_readiness: Each promoted child must have at least six gold/silver positives across at least three sequence/Foldseek clusters, with no single cluster contributing more than half of positives.
Each child must have within-parent PLP sibling hard negatives and non-PLP Schiff-base/OOS controls in the same evaluation split design.

Source-free geometry must identify PLP/LLP/PMP state plus the child reaction-center evidence: amino transfer donor/acceptor, decarboxylated carboxylate, racemization dual-face acid/base, elimination leaving group, or beta/gamma replacement entering/leaving group.
External positive-like rows must clear exact sequence, UniRef-style, and Foldseek/TM duplicate screens before they count as support.
PLP plus adenosylcobalamin aminomutase rows must abstain or route to the coupled review-only family until a dedicated schema and scorer exist.
No child threshold or registry change is allowed until text/name/EC/cofactor-only ablations show signal survives without PLP recognition alone.
panel_pass_fail_gates: Parent PLP detection may remain high, but child calls must be evaluated separately from parent detection.
Non-PLP Schiff-base rows must not become PLP positives under name, lyase, or active-site Lys leakage.
Cobalamin-only rows must not become coupled PLP+B12 positives; m_csa:737 must not become plain PLP or plain cobalamin.
Heldout/current702 split assignment and structure-neighbor clustering must be frozen before any learned representation test.

learned_representation_test_requirements: Create evaluation-only child-stratum labels separate from production labels and keep them out of the canonical registry until gates pass.

Materialize a row-level feature table with selected structure, active-site residue roles, PLP/LLP/PMP state, substrate/analog ligand state, sequence split, Foldseek nearest neighbors, and child/control role.
Compute learned embeddings and geometry features under ablations that mask EC/name/reaction prose/cofactor-family fields; compare against cofactor-only and sequence-only baselines.
Use cluster-preserving train/test splits based on sequence and Foldseek/TM neighbors before reporting child metrics.
Report macro child F1, per-child AUROC/average precision, sibling-confusion matrix, OOS false-positive rate, and coupled-family abstention rate.
